A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SLS is a promising technology to produce complex shaped porous ceramic components for the purpose of energy saving and environmental protection.

the SLS technology has been successfully applied to the fabrication of complex shape porous mullite ceramic components with enhanced mechanical properties using MnO2 spheroidized double shell powders as feedstock.

the SLS formed porous mullite honeycomb ceramics could be used as a new type of catalyst carrier, and the Mn(Ac) 2*4H 2O content could be used as an important parameter to control the mechanical properties and pore size distribution of the porous mullite products.

the mechanical properties of the SLS formed porous mullite ceramic product could be dramatically enhanced by using MnO2 as sintering additive.
